name: clrouter
description: Routes each prompt to the model that fits it, and runs dev work as a plan/build/review pipeline with a model per role.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: pop up before switching; auto: switch silently; suggest: only say which model fits; off: do nothing.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: heuristic: keywords only, free and instant; hybrid: ask the small fast model when the keywords are unsure; model: always ask it.

downgradeMaxContext.title: Max context for a downgrade
downgradeMaxContext.description: Skip routing to a cheaper model once the conversation holds more tokens than this: re-reading it uncached costs more than it saves.
